verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the shores of the Atlantic Ocean at the foot of Teide.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the shores of the Atlantic Ocean and at the foot of Teide, a magical experience awaits you amidst the natural magnetism of Tenerife.

verified_facts.text: The resort is on the beachfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perfectly integrated into an exceptional natural setting on the beachfront, Gran Meliá Palacio de Isora is one of the most exclusive resorts in Tenerife.

verified_facts.text: The resort has direct access to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Direct access to the beach

verified_facts.text: The resort has a saltwater infinity pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: An oasis of tranquility thanks to its saltwater infinity pool, its 2000 m2 spa, and suites with the most exclusive RedLevel distinction.

verified_facts.text: The spa is Spa by Clarins, which pairs Clarins products with manual massage techniques.
verified_facts.excerpt: Subtle alchemy between highly efficient products created by Clarins, manual massage techniques and a sensorial environment that seeks the deepest well-being.

verified_facts.text: The spa's water circuit includes a sauna, chromotherapy, hydromassage, essence showers, bi-thermal foot baths and a meditation area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our water circuit includes a sauna, chromotherapy, hydromassage, essence showers, bi-thermal foot baths and a meditation area.

verified_facts.text: Booking any spa treatment or massage includes one complimentary access to the water circuit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy one complimentary access when booking any treatment or massage.

verified_facts.text: RedLevel guests get access to a private lounge, private check-in and check-out, and an a la carte breakfast in a private area.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Access to the private Lounge
Access to a private pool
Private check-in and check-out
À la carte breakfast in a private area

verified_facts.text: The RedLevel Villa with Private Pool is a beachfront villa with a furnished garden and heated pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Family holidays become a brand-new experience in this private beachfront villa. Enjoy this privileged stay at the main resort, designed with a furnished garden and heated pool.

verified_facts.text: The villas come with personalised butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- Private pool
- Access to the Premium Lounge
- Whirlpool bathtub
- Personalised butler service

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Ocean Front View room has a private terrace with panoramic views of the Atlantic.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed for sea lovers, this room features a private terrace with spectacular panoramic views of the Atlantic.

verified_facts.text: Dos Naifes by Jorge Peñate was awarded a Sol Repsol in 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: It also stands out for its gastronomic concept at the Dos Naifes by Jorge Peñate restaurant, awarded a Sol Repsol 2025.

verified_facts.text: At Dos Naifes, chefs Jorge Peñate and Luis Martín focus on marine biodiversity and local seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chefs Jorge Peñate and Luis Martín have created a unique proposal in the Canary Islands that champions marine biodiversity and local seafood.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a private stargazing experience at Mount Teide with an accredited Starlight guide and long-range telescopes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private astronomical experience at Mount Teide with accredited Starlight guide, exclusive planetarium access and professional stargazing using long-range telescopes

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers private sailing trips along the Tenerife coast aboard a Bavaria 46 Cruiser with a cetacean guide, with chances to spot dolphins and pilot whales.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the trip, guests will have the chance to spot dolphins and pilot whales in their natural habitat, whilst always adhering to respectful conservation practices.

verified_facts.text: A private guided outing explores the lava fields of the Malpaís de Rasca and ends with a volcanic wine tasting in Vilaflor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private guided experience through the Malpaís de Rasca in English or Spanish, exploration of volcanic landscapes and historical areas, lunch at a local restaurant, visit to a winery in Vilaflor and wine tasting

verified_facts.text: The Mar de Nubes kids' club is a supervised area for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: The little ones also have access to the Mar de Nubes kids' club, an area specially reserved and supervised for children.

verified_facts.text: The resort has tennis and paddle tennis courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the hotel tennis or paddle tennis courts.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly; dogs can be added to a booking as an extra service.
verified_facts.excerpt: To book a stay with your dog, please go to the booking process, choose your room category, rate, and add the extra pet friendly service.

verified_facts.text: The private experiences are subject to weather conditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: The experience is subject to weather conditions.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is very close to golf courses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Modernity and natural light for celebrations, very close to the golf courses

verified_facts.text: Gym personal training, nutritional guidance and customised training programmes carry an extra charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: It also offers personal training services, nutritional guidance and customised training programmes (extra charge).
